scope: Read-only factual refresh of prepared seven-player and nine-player batches before release.
result: No factual decision change found in retrieved primary sources for the prepared 16 players.
method: Retrieved original primary-source articles and individual AFL public player profiles through web retrieval; compared names, DOBs, completed selection, current-club statements and playing roles with the prepared artifacts. Retrieved content can be cached by the search provider; this is not a fresh raw HTTP hash recapture.
originalPageHashLimitation: The original /tmp/docked-afl-roster-source-cache directory is unavailable in this runtime. Original page SHA256 values are retained as prior capture evidence, not represented as independently rehashed in this refresh.

releaseBoundaries: Refresh canonical IDs, aliases and expected roster revisions against current Production before applying either unchanged batch.
Existing issued cards, ownership, serials, trading rules and already allocated sealed-pack contents remain unchanged.

New identity registration creates dormant/unapproved definitions only; activation requires its own valid rights reference and current revision under the existing application contract.
No production data, award, balance, deployment or source payload was mutated by this evidence review.
